upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git svn or mercurial to the codereview.appspot.com code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using git svn or mercurial version control
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP upload requests
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin to obtain auth tokens and cookies for the review server
split_patch_by_file: split a unified diff output into separate patches for each individual file
